newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian finmin office searched in bank fraud probe.
newsitem.headline: Belgian finmin office searched in bank fraud probe.

text.p: Belgian Finance Minister Philippe Maystadt's cabinet was searched by Belgian court officials on Monday morning in a probe into suspected tax fraud by Belgian banks, a Maystadt spokesman said.

"The offices of the finance ministry cabinet and of the administration have been searched by the judicial police. This was in the framework of a probe into tax practices by certain banks," the spokesman told Reuters.
But the spokesman said Maystadt's personal office had not been searched.
RTL television said some cabinet officials' private residences had also been searched.
Maystadt said he did not know what the search was about.
"I have had no contact with the magistrates. I have to find out what this is about. I am relaxed," Maystadt told RTL.
In recent weeks, Maystadt has been dogged by reports in the Belgian press saying that he had been lenient to certain banks with regard to tax cases.
